gist.summary: Corrected DeepSeek V4.1 Flash pricing per million input, cached and output tokens to match its Fireworks primary provider costs. Its Quest + Paid access and OpenRouter → DeepInfra FP8 fallback are unchanged. DeepSeek V4 Pro remains Paid-only at 1.184 / 0.118 / 3.551 Pollen per million input/cached/output tokens. Its OpenRouter → Alibaba primary configuration now uses base rather than us-east-1 costs, matching that price. The OpenRouter → StreamLake fallback cost was corrected to 0.696 / 0.023 / 2.089 per million input/cached/output tokens under a 50% promo with no stated end date; post-promo costs would exceed Pro’s price. Capabilities are unchanged. Primary and forced-fallback checks covered text, streaming, tools and prompt caching for both models, plus vision for Flash.

Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream background and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
